{{Top|leg}}
The '''Mishtak''' people were [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] members, some of which were part of the non-[[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] community present on [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], during an anti-Bothan demonstration set off by the discovery of the [[Caamas Document]], a Mishtak was hit by a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] bolt. Though the blaster bolt was blamed by the crowd on either [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] or a Bothan clan leader named [[Rayl'skar]], it was later discovered that the bolt was set off by an [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] agent working for the [[Vengeance (organization)|"Vengeance" cell]] using a [[Nightstinger sporting blaster rifle|Xerrol Nightstinger]].
